meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: the nesting egg — 'this is how it needs to be'
meta.verdict: The pasted text's three-way distinction (nested vs recursive vs self-improving) is correct and adopted. Its question is answered below: RECURSIVE.

recursive_nesting.law: The nesting is RECURSIVE, not merely nested. Any inner kernel/layer can itself generate a further inner layer. Outer shell (knowledge) -> reasoning engine (derivation) -> inner kernel (method) -> verified computation — and any layer can birth the next.

three_properties.nested: Components contain or invoke other components (the Russian doll).
three_properties.recursive: A component can repeat the same generative process on smaller or newly generated problems — kernels birthing kernels.
three_properties.self_improving: Evaluation results change future behavior and artifacts (ledger + Corvus read-back + rarity selection already do this).

recursive_nesting.termination: Recursion has a base case and a gate: a generated layer must be independently testable before it can generate further; depth beyond the designed layers queues at Mira's Gate. No unbounded turtle stacks.
recursive_nesting.traceability: Every inner layer's results trace back through every outer layer — the ledger records the full chain. Independently testable at each layer, auditable through all layers.
recursive_nesting.mapping: Outer shell = Raijin Social (language/algorithm knowledge). Reasoning engine = Brain + Mira (derivation). Inner kernel = BUBO/Kido line (computational method). Verified computation = ledger + MATER audit.
